title: Stopped by police (Policja)
question: What should I do if police stop me in Poland?
short_answer: Stay calm, show your ID, passport or Karta Pobytu. You are legally required to identify yourself. You have the right to know why you were stopped.
conditions: Police have the right to check your identity at any time
You must present a valid ID, passport, or Karta Pobytu
Police must show their badge (legitymacja) upon request
You have the right to ask why you were stopped
You may record the interaction in a public place
If detained, you have the right to notify a family member and a lawyer
Detention without charge cannot exceed 48 hours
exceptions: Children under 17 cannot be questioned without a parent or guardian present
If you do not have documents on you, you must give your name, surname, address and date of birth
You can be detained up to 24h for establishing identity if you refuse to give it
penalties: Refusing to identify yourself: fine up to 500 PLN or arrest up to 30 days
Obstructing police: fine up to 1000 PLN or arrest
Assault on officer: criminal charge, up to 3 years in prison
